meta.title: Adding a lot weight for an invited vendor makes the round a weighted round
gaps: The available read-back fields do not expose the saved weight scope (lot), weight keys (qa_freight_adj and weighted_total), or QA vendor 1's saved value of 100.
The available vocabulary does not provide a response assertion for HTTP 200 or the message 'Weights added successfully!' from the weight update request.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the trade edit weight parameters request, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “rfx mode” equals weighted.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “rfx mode” equals weighted.
